steps.prompt: A small floating sky island diorama: an upside-down cone of layered ochre and cream limestone rock underneath, a flat grassy top carrying a tall slender steel lattice water tower painted plum with a big rounded cream water tank on top covered in colourful paint drips running down. Photograph of a real glossy designer vinyl art-toy collectible, smooth sculpted soft-vinyl and lacquered resin surfaces, saturated candy paint colours with real paint drips, crisp studio product lighting, high detail. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
